title: 4521-ESP-ANC-00-50-2300
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles, extended payment and certification periods.
- Confidential proprietary information of Abener.
- Instructions for initialing cover sheet and identifying revisions in the specification.
- General summary includes excavation, trenching, site filling, backfilling, compaction, and landscape grading.
- References include standards and codes like ANSI/ASTM D698 and OSHA Title 29-Labor.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles, extended payment, and certification/approval periods.
- Confidential information must not be disclosed without permission.
- Fill materials include coarse aggregate, sand, excavated subsoils, stabilized soil, flowable fill, coarse aggregate fill, fly ash, and concrete.
- Top soil must be friable, fertile, loamy, and free from deleterious matter.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Owner can make payment within 180 days after certification and approval of billings and estimates.
- Owner can certify and approve billings and estimates within 30 days after receipt.
summary_points: Contract allows alternate billing cycles, extended payment and certification periods.
Confidential proprietary information of Abener.
Instructions for initialing cover sheet and identifying revisions in the specification.
General summary includes excavation, trenching, site filling, backfilling, compaction, and landscape grading.
References include standards and codes like ANSI/ASTM D698 and OSHA Title 29-Labor.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles, extended payment, and certification/approval periods.
Confidential information must not be disclosed without permission.
Fill materials include coarse aggregate, sand, excavated subsoils, stabilized soil, flowable fill, coarse aggregate fill, fly ash, and concrete.
Top soil must be friable, fertile, loamy, and free from deleterious matter.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Owner can make payment within 180 days after certification and approval of billings and estimates.
Owner can certify and approve billings and estimates within 30 days after receipt.
Examination includes verifying survey benchmarks and fill materials.
Preparation involves identifying utilities, protecting structures, and preparing subgrade.
Excavation requires special precautions, compacting soils, and grading.
Final excavation should prevent disturbance of subgrade material.
Contractor must comply with State and Federal regulations on excavation.
Excess material must be hauled and stored as directed.
Owner can request extended payment within 180 days after certification and approval of billings and estimates.
Confidential information is proprietary to Abener.
Trenching specifications refer to another document (Spec. 4251).
Fill areas with unfrozen materials, avoiding porous surfaces.
Backfill soft subgrade areas with appropriate fill and compact to required density.
Install crushed stone beneath building slabs for compaction.
Compacted areas should maintain optimal moisture content.
Scarify topsoil before placing, especially near buildings.
Gradually grade slopes away from buildings.
Remove surplus fill materials from the site.
Owner can request payment within 180 days after certification and approval of billings and estimates.
Confidential information must be protected according to contract terms.
Tolerances for backfilling under paved areas and general backfilling are specified.
Field quality control includes smooth, uniform surfaces and compaction testing.
Compaction tests should be performed at least once per 100 feet of trench length and one test per 1,000 square feet per lift.
Protection measures include preventing cave-ins, removing water from excavations, and protecting soil from freezing.
Contractor must comply with State and Federal regulations for open excavations.
